upstream_context.artist_meaning_summary: Preserve the unresolved threshold: nearness to release should intensify pressure without becoming triumph.

emotional_tension_review.intended_feeling_reviewed: the ache of being close to release but unable to choose it
minimum_tension_criteria_reviewed: The album should sustain withheld crossing across tracks and covers.
The calibration track and Track Cover should be coherent enough to test before full expansion.

tension_intensity_assessments.assessment_note: The shared sonic and visual rules keep the threshold unresolved and prevent a triumphant crossing.
Track 1 and its Track Cover are justified as representative tests for sound, visual direction, and sound-visual fit.

key_emotional_movements_reviewed.review_note: The package keeps the threshold movement active through the Calibration Track and the first Track Cover.
The later track mapping preserves residue as a planned expansion target without rushing it before calibration.

expectation_turns_reviewed.review_note: The first track sets up approach as near release that remains withheld.
The second track is mapped to deepen the doorway pressure instead of resolving it.
The final track is held for later expansion as unresolved aftermath.

emotional_tension_review.reviewer_conclusion: The Release Package Plan is coherent enough to approve for representative Album Calibration planning.

matched.summary: Required Album v1 deliverables are present before calibration.

traces_to.note: The plan includes package title, description, album cover, one sound prompt deliverable per track, and one Track Cover deliverable per track.

matched.summary: Album Sonic System and Album Visual System have clear boundaries.

traces_to.note: The sonic system governs shared pressure, motifs, and production constraints without replacing Sound Medium Plans.
The visual system governs shared cover language without replacing Image Medium Plans.

matched.summary: Long-Work Stewardship supports the album arc before expansion.

traces_to.note: The stewardship record maps tracks to parts and keeps cumulative drift visible.

findings.evidence: The plan approves coordination and calibration planning only; it does not approve provider-backed generation.
findings.recommendation: Proceed to Release Package Plan Approval Gate, then representative Medium Plans and Album Calibration.

recommended_revision: No blocking revision required before package approval.
